# Circular Sentence.

@example keep ends with the p that pulse begins with, pulse ends with the e that elk begins with, and elk ends with the k that keep begins with.
"keep pulse elk"
=> true

@example The words link up in order, but eagle ends with e, not with the n of night.
"night tide eagle"
=> false

@example A single word that begins with N and ends with n; case counts.
"Noon"
=> false

# A single letter begins and ends with itself.
"x"
=> true

# A single word with two different letters.
"ab"
=> false

# The only mismatch is the case of B and b.
"taB bat"
=> false

# Capital letters that match exactly.
"Ab bA"
=> true

# Each word begins and ends with the same letter, but the words don't link.
"pop did"
=> false

# The words link, though no word begins and ends with the same letter.
"ten nab bat"
=> true

# A one-letter word in the middle has to match on both sides.
"ab b ba"
=> true

# Only the first link is broken.
"ab c ca"
=> false

# Only the last link between two words is broken.
"sun nod dim mat ops"
=> false

# The first and last letters match, but a link in the middle is broken.
"spin nap rot toys"
=> false

# A one-letter last word: the link into it is broken, the closing link holds.
"kiwi inn k"
=> false

# A one-letter first word whose link to the next word is broken.
"t on nut"
=> false

# A one-letter last word that links on both sides.
"kiwi ink k"
=> true

# 250 one-letter words, all the same: 499 characters.
"z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z z"
=> true

# A single word of 500 letters, beginning and ending with Q.
""
=> true

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"A Ab bbA"
=> true

@gen 2 small
"Aaa"
=> false

@gen 3 small
"ab aab bba aa"
=> false

@gen 4 small
"ab b bA A"
=> false

@gen 5 small
"ab ba"
=> true

@gen 6 small
"A Aa"
=> false

"c c c c c c c c c c B c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c c"
